notes: FILM-STATIONEN (Clips 10-12). All printed words reviewed at 2x: blue "Clips 10-12" label, task 1 heading + statements a-f (letters recovered via 4x zoom), task 2 heading + green bank, all 11 schedule time labels (times recovered via 2x zoom OCR: 9:30/10:00/10:00-11:00/11:00-13:00/13:00/14:00/14:00-16:30/16:30-18:00/18:00-18:30/18.30/19:00-21:00), printed handwriting examples (Croissants backen, Zeitung holen, Kaffee machen / reden, Wasser trinken, einkaufen - Wasser recovered via 4x zoom), speech-bubble example (Gestern hat Martin bis halb zehn geschlafen. Dann ...), task 3 heading + green bank (im Winter vor 20 Jahren split from merged OCR), photo corner letters A-D, table column letters A-D and row labels, handwriting example cell im Winter vor 20 Jahren (the "20" recovered via 8x zoom).

Fields: task 1 = 6 checkbox circles (answers key-verified, Film-Stationen 1: Richtig a, d, e; circles via CC ring detection at threshold 228). Task 2 = 9 write-in schedule blanks (answers key-verified, Film-Stationen 2; rows "bis 10:00 Uhr" and "von 16:30 Uhr bis 18:00 Uhr" carry printed handwriting examples, so no fields there; blank lines via CC line detection). Task 3 = 13 write-in table cells (answers key-verified, Film-Stationen 3: A Faschingsfest/Oesterreich/(example)/lustig, B Annas Geburtstagsfeier/Leipzig/letzten Mai/toll, C Betriebsfeier/in der Firma/am Freitag/langweilig, D Fuehrerscheinpruefung geschafft/vor einem Jahr). A-Wann carries the printed handwriting example (im Winter vor 20 Jahren); the D-Wo and D-Wie cells carry printed "no entry" dash lines and have no key answers, so they are not fields.
DVD clips 10-12 have no playable assets in the app; clip markers (Clip 10/11/12) excluded from words and audio, consistent with earlier Film-Stationen pages.
Excluded per policy: gold FILM-STATIONEN outline header, red task numerals 1/2/3, photos and photo frames, bank separator bars, footer (Modul 4 tab, 70, siebzig), facing-page bleed.
